Subject: Talent capacity scenarios — QBR ask

Team —

As we prep for the FY27 QBR (week of May 24) I want a short, decision-ready set of talent scenarios for the exec deck. I need three scenarios by EOD May 18:

- Base: maintain current hiring cadence + only critical backfills
- Growth: accelerate top-priority hires (product, infra, inference) — comfortable with +6 FTEs this quarter
- Conservative: freeze non-critical roles; backfills only for SRE/security-critical roles

For each scenario please include: headcount delta by function, two highest-risk gaps (impact on OKRs), and estimated run-rate delta (month-on-month cost). Call out any reqs that require exec exceptions (comp/level/exception notes).

Deliverables:
- Spreadsheet with per-req rows and scenario toggles (one tab per scenario)
- One-page summary (pdf) with recommended ask and suggested talking points for QBR

Markus — can you own the spreadsheet? Laura — can you validate prioritization for product/customer-facing teams?

Also loop in Talent Ops if any reqs will need special approval cadence (Miriam at Acme is our external contractor for contingent roles; pinged for context).

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
